subject: Shadow traffic beta: oncall readiness + alerting requirements
related_links: Jira: SUP-28510 (shadow traffic increases metrics cardinality alerts)
body:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 7, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Shadow traffic beta: oncall readiness + alerting requirements

Marissa / Logan / Priya —

As we get closer to the Dedicated beta for shadow traffic + quality metrics, I want to lock oncall readiness criteria (what must be in place before we enable for any external tenant).

Below is the minimum bar from SRE. Please reply with (a) any objections, and (b) owners + ETA for the action items.

1) Dashboards (must exist before beta enablement)
- Shadow health overview (per region, per tenant):
  - shadow_mirror_attempt_rate vs shadow_mirror_success_rate
  - shadow_target_error_rate (4xx/5xx) + timeout rate
  - circuit_breaker_open (count + % time open)
- Scoring pipeline health:
  - scoring_queue_depth, oldest_message_age
  - scoring_worker_success_rate / retry_rate / DLQ rate
  - scoring_lag_p50/p95 (event time -> score persisted)
- Quality deltas (beta view):
  - top-level delta charts with confidence bands (we can keep segmenting minimal to avoid cardinality blowups)

2) Paging rules (explicit, so oncall knows what to do)
Page (P1/P2):
- Control-plane/data-plane impact only:
  - Any evidence shadowing is affecting user path latency/error (should be near-zero by design)
  - Unexpected increase in route-level p99 latency correlated with shadow enablement
- Shadow safety/overhead breach:
  - circuit_breaker_open > 5% of the last 10 min across a region OR > 15 min continuous
  - scoring_queue_oldest_age > 30 min for >= 15 min (beta) OR DLQ growth sustained
Ticket (non-page):
- Quality regression alerts (advisory) unless we explicitly turn on automated rollback (I assume we are NOT doing that in beta).

3) Kill switches (need to be unambiguous)
- Tenant-level kill switch: disable shadowing for a specific tenant/route in < 5 minutes (no redeploy).
- Global kill switch: disable shadowing across a region (or fleet) if we see systemic overhead.
- Scoring kill switch: stop scoring workers without affecting ingestion (and vice versa) to arrest cost.

4) Runbooks (must be linked from every page)
- “Disable shadowing” steps and verification queries
- “Scoring backlog” triage and backpressure knobs
- “Cardinality explosion” mitigation (dimensions to drop/bucket + config defaults)

5) Ownership / oncall routing
- Which rotation gets paged for what? My proposal:
  - Data-plane impact: Core SRE oncall (page)
  - Pipeline/scoring lag: Observability / Telemetry oncall (page if thresholds above)
  - Quality regression: ticket to Applied ML + Product (no page)

If we can align today, I’ll add this as the beta enablement checklist and ask EPM to gate the tenant enablement flag on it.

Thanks,
Sean

—
Sean Gallagher
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference



From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 7, 2026 at 10:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Shadow traffic beta: oncall readiness + alerting requirements

Agree on the bar.

Telemetry / dashboards status:
- We have the “shadow pair ingestion” dashboards stubbed from the observability pack PR. It currently shows:
  - mirror attempts/success
  - shadow target timeout/error
  - ingestion lag (Kafka -> warehouse)
- What’s missing (we can add early next week):
  - scoring queue oldest age + queue depth (we have metrics in the worker but not wired into the shared dashboard yet)
  - circuit_breaker_open trend view (we emit a gauge but need the panel)

On paging thresholds:
- +1 on scoring_queue_oldest_age page at 30m/15m sustained. We should also page if the queue is growing faster than drain for >20m (we can approximate with slope on depth).

Kill switches:
- Confirmed we have:
  - feature flag: shadow.enabled (global)
  - policy override: shadow.sample_rate = 0 for tenant/route (config update)
- I’m less sure we have a single “stop scoring only” switch that’s guaranteed to be fast. We can add a worker-side flag (read from config service, refresh 30s) so we can pause consumption.

Action items I’ll take:
- Wire worker metrics into the shared dashboards + add alert rules in the same place as other pipeline alerts.
- Define exact alert rules for scoring lag + DLQ growth.

Logan

—
Logan Wright
Eng Lead, Telemetry & Analytics



From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 7, 2026 at 11:27 AM PST
Subject: Re: Shadow traffic beta: oncall readiness + alerting requirements

+1 to all of this, with one nuance on the “Quality regression alerts” line.

For beta, I’d like:
- Quality regression alerts to show in Console + notify the experiment owner via email/Slack (non-page).
- No automatic rollback, and no paging based on quality deltas.

Reason: we expect early metric calibration noise + rubric version churn. Paging would create churn and the action is ambiguous.

On the dashboard side: the minimum UX needs are already in the Console spec (delta chart w/ CI, plus a “scoring status” indicator). We can link to the SRE dashboards from the Console “System status” section as well.

Sean — can you also add one readiness item around “beta customer comms”? I want the enablement flow to include:
- explicit warning that shadowing is fail-open and does not change user responses
- explicit retention defaults and where to request changes (esp Dedicated)

Marissa

—
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Console & Rollouts



From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 7, 2026 at 1:09 PM PST
Subject: Re: Shadow traffic beta: oncall readiness + alerting requirements

Approved with two constraints:

1) Hard guarantee that shadow cannot degrade control path.
I know this is the design intent; I want the oncall checklist to explicitly require:
- timeouts on the shadow target that are strictly bounded and do not consume shared thread pools
- circuit breaker defaults enabled (not optional per tenant)

2) Global kill switch must be documented and exercised.
Before any external tenant: run a game-day in staging or internal dogfood where we:
- enable shadowing at a non-trivial sampling rate
- simulate scoring backlog
- verify kill switch disables without requiring a deploy

Marissa’s point stands: quality regression stays advisory for beta.

Priya

—
Priya Natarajan
VP Platform, Redwood Inference



From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 7, 2026 at 5:48 PM PST
Subject: Re: Shadow traffic beta: oncall readiness + alerting requirements

Thanks all — aligning on the following and I’ll translate into the beta gate checklist.

Decisions
- Paging:
  - Page only for (a) any control-path impact, or (b) safety/overhead breaches (circuit breaker / scoring lag / DLQ).
  - Quality regression alerts are advisory (non-page) for beta.
- Kill switches required:
  - Global shadow.enabled (regional/fleet scoped) and tenant/route override (sample_rate=0)
  - Worker “pause consumption” switch for scoring (Logan to add)
- Guardrails:
  - Shadow target timeout bounded; circuit breaker on by default; fail-open enforced
- Readiness includes a game-day to exercise kill switches + backlog scenario.

Action items / owners
- Logan:
  - Add scoring queue panels (oldest age, depth, slope) + DLQ panels
  - Implement alert rules for: scoring_queue_oldest_age, DLQ growth, circuit_breaker_open sustained
  - Add worker-side pause flag (config refresh <= 30s)
- Sean (SRE):
  - Update runbooks to include: disable shadowing (tenant + global), scoring backlog triage, cardinality blowup mitigation
  - Define oncall routing in PagerDuty (Core SRE vs Observability) and link in the alert annotations
  - Schedule + run game-day (target next Wed/Thu; will send invite)
- Marissa:
  - Add enablement checklist item to beta onboarding doc: comms/warnings (retention defaults, fail-open, costs)
- Priya:
  - No further items; I’ll route the final checklist for your quick sign-off once it’s in Confluence.

One more note: we should ensure the alert annotations link directly to the specific runbook section + the dashboard panel, not just the general dashboard.

Have a good weekend,
Sean

—
Sean Gallagher
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
